key_insight: An Attention Residual U-Net aims to improve cross-dataset polyp localization by learning lesion-focused spatial features before generating bounding boxes.
clinical_relevance: More robust localization could support automated polyp detection across varied endoscopic devices and imaging conditions, but clinical benefit remains unproven.
method: Combine residual feature propagation with multi-scale contextual learning.
Use attention to suppress irrelevant encoder features before decoding.
Convert learned spatial representations into bounding boxes at inference.
evidence_signal: Evaluation on multiple public endoscopy datasets from different devices reported up to 22.0% improvement in AUC over relevant state-of-the-art methods.
watch_item: The abstract does not specify dataset sizes, absolute AUC values, or whether the reported improvement is relative or absolute.
paper_title: Attention Residual U-Net for Enhanced Cross-Dataset Polyp Localization in Endoscopy
